program: California Youth Crisis Line, youth-homelessness advocacy and member support

nutshell.headline: A real statewide crisis line, but no CalYouth-linked distal health outcomes.
nutshell.body: A $100,000 signed illustration is $440,440 donor and $527,427 illustrative gross resources per 10 QALYs. Central is $541,791. The only sub-$100,000 result is a favorable stress case.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: CalHHS reports 16,740 annual calls averaged over 2014–2023, and external studies observe proximal distress reductions during crisis calls.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Calls are not people or resolved crises; mortality credit is zero; repeat overlap, 988 displacement, marginal use and local shares are unresolved.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: Obtain current unique/repeat contact structure, answer rates, severity, warm handoffs, follow-up outcomes, funding restrictions and a next-$100K staffing plan.

programSection.body: The full legal entity runs the crisis line, statewide policy and legislative advocacy, member networking, youth leadership, public education, and the Youth Empowerment Summit.

steps.title: Answer crisis contacts
steps.detail: Staff and trained volunteers provide 24/7 counseling.

steps.title: Connect youth to services
steps.detail: Referrals and warm connections use a statewide resource directory.

steps.title: Change youth systems
steps.detail: Policy, member advocacy, conferences and youth participation.

programSection.boundary: All FY2025 expense is charged. Only conditional finite crisis-contact morbidity receives QALYs; mortality and every other pathway receive zero.

model.headline: Weighted $440K donor / $527K illustrative gross per 10 QALYs.
model.body: The model uses calls, never unique people. QALY/contact is a finite net episode sensitivity after repeat overlap, not a study estimate.

equation.label: CENTRAL
equation.expression: 16,740 calls × ($100K/$1.214M) ×45% deployability ×35% non-displaced access ×85% realization ×.010 QALY

inputs.label: Deployability
inputs.basis: Donation names line; no priced marginal allocation.

inputs.label: Non-displaced access
inputs.basis: 988, county lines and other supports create substitution.

inputs.label: Finite net QALY/additional contact
inputs.basis: Zero mortality credit; 1.83-day harm to 10.96-day favorable morbidity equivalent.

inputs.label: Gross-resource proxy
inputs.basis: Illustrative volunteer/training/referral resources; not audited or a lower bound.

inputs.label: Bay / SF impact share
inputs.basis: Rounded analyst population-share priors. Bay means Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma; SF is nested.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Favorable stress supplies 72.69% of signed expected QALYs; no causal mortality estimate is used.
model.fundingBoundary: Health-producing marginal RFMF is plausible but unverified and unpriced.

evidence.transfer: Calls may repeat and do not establish outcomes.

evidence.result: Most level-four evidence; 80% high risk of bias; high-quality effectiveness evidence lacking.
Suicidality fell during calls; hopelessness and psychological pain continued falling.

evidence.transfer: Full expense charged; marginal allocation unknown.
